competencies.label: Sampling Methodology
competencies.description: Select sampling designs and calculate defensible weights.

competencies.label: Digital Tools
competencies.description: Use spreadsheets and digital survey tools with reproducible checks.

competencies.label: Critical Thinking
competencies.description: Identify assumptions, investigate inconsistencies and justify decisions.

competencies.label: Survey Data Collection
competencies.description: Apply survey instructions and record respondent information accurately.

competencies.label: Communication
competencies.description: Explain statistical tasks clearly and engage respondents respectfully.

competencies.label: Sampling Frames and UFS
competencies.description: Maintain complete, nonoverlapping and identifiable urban sampling units.

competencies.label: Geospatial Tools
competencies.description: Check boundaries and edit geospatial layers for frame maintenance.

competencies.label: Industrial Statistics
competencies.description: Interpret enterprise variables and validate industrial survey records.

competencies.label: Statistical Analysis
competencies.description: Analyze statistical data with appropriate methods and transparent checks.

competencies.label: Price Statistics
competencies.description: Validate quotations and compile interpretable price indices.

competencies.label: Statistical Computing
competencies.description: Write reproducible statistical data transformations and calculations.

competencies.label: National Accounts
competencies.description: Compile and reconcile output, intermediate consumption and GVA estimates.

competencies.label: Statistical Data Management
competencies.description: Manage statistical records, versioning, quality controls and data lifecycles.

competencies.label: Data Privacy and Disclosure Control
competencies.description: Assess disclosure risk and apply defensible statistical protection methods.

competencies.label: Metadata and Dissemination
competencies.description: Prepare definitions, provenance, quality notes and release-ready metadata.

competencies.label: Leadership
competencies.description: Coach staff, delegate work and oversee quality and delivery.

competencies.label: Collaboration
competencies.description: Coordinate handoffs and resolve cross-team dependencies.

competencies.label: Strategic Thinking
competencies.description: Set priorities and justify capability investments using evidence.

course_learning_outcomes.description: Build and independently check a spreadsheet summary of fictional survey records.
Document spreadsheet validation steps and reproduce the summary.
Document a statistical dataset lifecycle with access, retention and versioning decisions.
Identify data-management controls missing from a fictional handoff.
Allocate a proportional stratified sample of 120 across populations of 800 and 400.
Calculate inverse-probability weights and justify the sampling design.
Identify three inconsistent records and distinguish source error from genuine variation.
Write a documented decision trail for resolving a disputed outlier.
Explain a survey purpose without implying mandatory disclosure beyond instructions.
Conduct a neutral clarification exchange and document the response.
Calculate a weighted mean from fictional unit records.
Explain how missingness and outliers affect an estimate.
Detect a unit mismatch in three price quotations.
Calculate a fixed-basket index and explain its limitations.
Identify direct and quasi-identifiers in a fictional microdata extract.
Compare disclosure-risk reduction and information loss under two protections.
Produce a codebook containing units, missing-value codes and definitions.
Prepare a release note explaining revisions and permitted interpretation.
Allocate three review tasks with named fictional owners and completion criteria.
Evaluate a coaching response against a four-part rubric.
Resolve a conflicting variable definition in a simulated team handoff.
Produce an agreed versioned handoff checklist.
Prioritize three training investments against documented competency gaps.
Define measurable indicators and risks for a six-month capability plan.
